Did you know the Shiba Inu is the smallest of Japan's six native dog breeds? 🐕🇯🇵

Bred to flush game, this agile hunting dog copes well with mountainous terrain and hiking trails. They feature standard colors like red, sesame, and black and tan with a white ventral color called uraji
